'''Navik''', also known as '''Navik the Red''', was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] who served as the [[Grand Protector/Legends|Grand Protector]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] gained his nickname from the [[Color/Legends|red]] [[birthmark]] on his face. His given name, "Navik," was [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]] for "dark" and was considered to be a prophetic name.

==Biography==
"Navik" was [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]] for "dark".<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Navik was called "the Red" because a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[birthmark]] covered his face. During the reign of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Navik's tribe, the [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza]], used Rodia's traditional [[Rodian Clan Wars|wargames]] to attack other tribes.<ref name="AHF:GT" />

Displaying ruthlessness and determination, he became [[Chief Protector]] of his clan. He was leading attacks personally with his best [[Protector (Rin'na)|Protectors]]. He saw his clan Chattza became dominant on the planet and himself became Grand Protector, displaying the same iron hand.<ref name="SOTEPG" />

When Navik became the Grand Protector of Rodia, he disposed of anyone who opposed him in the government, by exiling or executing them. He moved the capital from [[Equator City/Legends|Equator City]] to [[Iskaayuma/Legends|Iskaayuma]], the Chattza settlement. The other clans were so weakened that they retreated to their holdings, and Navik suppressed attempts of some defiant clans to reinforce themselves. He also encouraged the segregation between urban and provincial population.<ref name="SOTEPG">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> A pretense to hunt and kill clans, and seizing their holdings, was their non-participation to obligatory gladiatorial contests.<ref name="negc">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

He attacked the [[Tetsu Clan]], wiping out many of their members, including [[Greedo the Elder]], and forcing the survivors, including [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo's son and namesake]], to flee the planet to worlds such as [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="AHF:GT" /> Not content with exiling them, he tracked down many survivors throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and killed them.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> A notable exception was the Tetsu [[Avaro Sookcool]]; his allegiance to the powerful [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], with which Navik wanted to keep a neutral stance, ensured his safety on Rodia.<ref name="sotesb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="negc" />

Navik tightened traffic around Rodia, enforced by his [[Rodian Home Fleet]], in an attempt to limit the resources and off-world influence of his enemies; part of this policy was the law that incoming ships should land only on four [[spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the whole planet. As such, the Chattza clan's rivals, the [[An'yettu clan]], were prevented from leaving [[An'yettu Islands/Legends|their island home]] by Navik.<ref name="SOTEPG" /> 

During his rule, he ordered off-world Rodian [[bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to report to him on their assignments and bosses's actions in order to understand the politics of the Empire and the ecosystem of criminal organizations. Additionally, he kept a neutral stance towards Black Sun; his clanman, [[Clezo]], attained the rank of [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]], providing Navik with inside information.<ref name="SOTEPG" /> Clezo however secretly planned to replace Navik with a Black Sun agent.<ref name="sotesb" />

He remained in his position throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> Providing bounty hunters to the Empire for its interests, he maintained good relations with the Empire, as well as the planetary Governor; the Imperial Governor was also satisfied with the isolationism and limited traffic Navik imposed on his own planet, and turned a blind eye on the reputed criminal activities of the Rodians. The Empire was aware that the populace feared and hated Navik more than they did the Emperor.<ref name="SOTEPG" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]'', the senator of Rodia's name is "Navik", but in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]'', the senator of Rodia's name is "[[Narik]]". ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'' says that "Navik" and "Narik" are both [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]] names, with "Navik" meaning "dark" and "Narik" meaning "light". ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' has separate entries for Navik the Red and Narik, with Navik the Red's entry making no reference to him being a Senator.
